quotes.text: It's no longer a realistic expectation for IT to be the gatekeeper to manually approve or deny everything. They cannot have one-on-one meetings with every innovator every day to walk them through the best practices.
quotes.speaker: Thomas Zou
quotes.why: Explains why agent governance has to shift from manual gatekeeping to automation and scale.

quotes.text: The one big best practice is never allow sensitive data to be accessed through agent that is unauthenticated, right? If you want to make sure that you expose sensitive data to specific people, then authentication needs to come in place with a lot of scrutiny.
quotes.speaker: Thomas Zou
quotes.why: A clear, actionable security rule for agents that touch sensitive data.

quotes.text: Try not to think about knowledge retention as progress because AI is replacing knowledge retention. What really defines progress is your ability to hone your craft and the difference between crafting and knowing is really the process of doing.
quotes.speaker: Thomas Zou
quotes.why: A thoughtful personal take on learning when innovation outpaces human capacity.

quotes.text: How do we govern and secure these increasingly more well connected, well-reasoned and autonomous agents? With greater capability comes with greater responsibility and governance and security needs to keep up.
quotes.speaker: Thomas Zou
quotes.why: Frames the next big governance challenge as agents become more autonomous.

Entra, Purview and securing sensitive data

takeaways: Agent governance should enable makers to innovate safely rather than block them, with IT acting as an enabling function.
Zoned governance with Power Platform environments, Agent 365, Entra and Purview lets organizations match controls to each agent's risk.
Successful agent adoption combines an AI center of excellence, executive sponsorship, champions and automated, self-service guidance.
hook: As organizations create hundreds or thousands of AI agents, IT faces the question of who owns, secures and governs them. In this interview, Thomas Zou from the Microsoft Copilot Studio team explains for IT leaders and admins how zoned governance, lifecycle management, Entra and Purview help scale agents safely without slowing innovation.
